title: Inventory: Brem et al. 2005 (Nature 436:701-703) sources
intro: The Nature article page (`../article.html`, fetched with a cookie jar from www.nature.com) carries only the abstract,
the two supplementary items and the references; the main text is paywalled there. The full text is the PubMed Central
author manuscript PMC1409747 (`PMC1409747.html`, fetched with a plain request from pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov), which is the
source of record for every statement the ingest uses. PMC's PDF and its copy of the supplementary figure answered with
a JavaScript proof-of-work page instead of the file; that check was not solved and the stubs were discarded.
NCBI E-utilities `efetch db=pmc` returns front matter only for this record (the publisher disallows full-text XML).
Statements used are quoted verbatim, with section, in `extracted/text_facts.tsv` (written by `extracted/extract_facts.py`).

roles.PMC1409747.html: PubMed Central author manuscript (full text): two-stage two-locus linkage of ~6,000 transcript levels in 112 BY x RM segregants, the MAT-GPA1 interacting locus pair, its confirmation with engineered strains, Figures 1-2 legends and Methods. No table of locus pairs.
roles.41586_2005_BFnature03865_MOESM1_ESM.ppt: Nature Supplementary Figure S1 (PowerPoint): transcript levels in segregants and engineered strains for the 18 transcripts linking to the MAT-GPA1 locus pair. Figure only; not parsed.
roles.41586_2005_BFnature03865_MOESM2_ESM.doc: Nature corrigendum (6 April 2006): an incorrect version of the Supplementary Figure was posted at publication and was replaced. Not parsed.

missing: No table of the 225 transcripts with a significant locus pair, or of their loci: the paper reports counts, Figure 1 (a histogram of locus-pair positions in 20 kb bins) and the one named pair, MAT-GPA1.
No marker positions or linkage statistics for any locus; the MAT and GPA1 loci are named by gene only.
No effect sizes in a table; Figure 2 and Supplementary Figure S1 plot expression by MAT-GPA1 genotype.
The per-transcript expression and genotype data come from Yvert et al. 2003 / Brem and Kruglyak 2005 (ref. 7) and are not part of this bundle.
